data.narrative:
Rebellions is a Series A semiconductor company with a current post-money valuation of $2.34B and $850M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 private peers in chips and semiconductors (including SambaNova Systems, d-Matrix, Cerebras, and Etched) plus 3 public semiconductor peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the $2.3B last post-money valuation, yielding $4.7B. Peer-median valuation anchors to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—SambaNova ($11.0B), d-Matrix ($2.0B), and Positron AI ($1.0B)—producing a median of $2.0B. Public-comparable anchoring using the public semiconductor median P/S of 18.4x cannot be applied, as target revenue is not disclosed. A fourth method requiring revenue multiples is not viable for private company data.

These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $1.7B–$5.4B, with a median of $3.3B. The current $2.34B post-money valuation sits within the lower-to-middle portion of this range. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations ($1.0B–$11.0B) and the absence of revenue data, which limits comparability to public comps and revenue-based methods.
